semiconductor_relevance: High — MicroAhead specializes in inspection and metrology equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MicroAhead Semiconductor Technology (SuZhou) Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells advanced inspection and metrology equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. The company focuses on independent innovation and provides reliable metrology solutions to address industry challenges.
capabilities: CV Probe systems for capacitance-to-voltage measurements
Resistivity measurement using 4 point probe techniques
Flatness and crystalline orientation measurement systems

regional_presence.China: The company is based in SuZhou, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
